counterfactuals.english: If the cook had washed the bowl, the guest would have used it.
counterfactuals.qaroshi: sen wënu nënugo gëla-m shëmiroli-te, dëra gëla-m pënari-te qinë.
counterfactuals.anaphoric_identity: gëla in consequent is the same bowl as gëla in antecedent
counterfactuals.limit: A contrary-to-fact wash condition does not entail that the bowl was actually washed or used.

counterfactuals.english: If the neighbor had closed the gate, the dog would have stayed inside.
counterfactuals.qaroshi: sen wënu shuna tëzhoza-m shëliroa-te, zemobo këna-lo nëra-te qinë.
counterfactuals.limit: Inside is a deictically understood interior; this does not entail the dog was originally outdoors or a human actually shut the gate.

additional_voice.scope: specialist in assembling wooden furniture, used in this narrowly defined carpenter role; table is a kind of furniture
additional_voice.limit: The exact carpenter role is a new contextual occupational sense; the source verb originally means assemble furniture. No generic tool is implied.

additional_instruments.new_sense: water hose used for cleaning a vehicle, not necessarily used in a garden
additional_instruments.limit: Physical hose as instrument only; no success of wash is inferred. The historic garden-hose meaning remains.
